content:
Based on the provided context, if you move from France to New Zealand, your life insurance coverage will change in the following ways:

1.  **Loss of GitLab-Provided Coverage:** In France, GitLab provides life insurance through Generali, allowing you to manage beneficiaries via their portal. However, GitLab does not plan to offer Life Insurance benefits to employees in New Zealand.
2.  **Reliance on Government and Personal Arrangements:** In New Zealand, you will no longer have company-provided life insurance. Instead, you can access government payments and services for illness, injury, or disability support. For life insurance specifically, many New Zealanders choose to arrange it personally through their KiwiSaver provider or other private arrangements.

Use the following context to answer the question.

Context:
[GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand > **GitLab PTY Ltd. Benefits - New Zealand** > **Financial Security** > **Life Insurance Information**]
GitLab does not plan at this time to offer Life Insurance benefits because New Zealanders can access [government payments and services](https://www.workandincome.govt.nz/providers/health-and-disability/helping-people-into-work/index.html) to help if they get ill, injured or have a disability.

Available Support

New Zealanders can access [government payments and services](https://www.workandincome.govt.nz/providers/health-and-disability-practitioners/health-and-disability-related-benefits.html) for illness, injury, or disability support.

Many New Zealanders choose to access life insurance through their KiwiSaver provider or other personal arrangements.

[Relocation > Relocation / Address Change > How To Apply for a Long-Term Relocation > Country Specific Tasks > South Korea, France or Singapore]
##### Relocating **to** South Korea

1. The People Operations Lead shares the relocation contract with gitlabHRSS@globalupside.com. Global Upside then sends an Egnyte (payroll platform) login invitation email to the relocating team member.

##### Relocating **to** France

1. [France requires contracts to be individually drafted by the Legal team.](/handbook/hiring)
1. Team member relocating to France will also receive an invite to Mihi (time tracking)

1. If a team member relocating to France is an expatriate who has not been a French tax resident for the 5 calendar years before the calendar year during which they relocate, and they wish to assess their eligibility for the impatriate tax regime, they must let People Operations know three months in advance that they will be undertaking the assessment. The People Operations team can reach out to legal-employment@gitlab.com for support with appropriate contract language once the relocating team member confirms their eligibility. *Note that eligibility is a complex tax matter and the relocating team member should check with their personal tax advisor.*

##### Relocating **from** France

[GitLab France S.A.S. > We've Got You Covered > Health & Wellbeing > Life Insurance and Disability]
1. Visit the [Generali beneficiary designation portal](https://designation-beneficiaires.generali.fr/)
2. Use the [scheme/contract number](https://docs.google.com/document/d/12muwdp-9XvQGO8B2cCGoEfZ7-dU2BeMY8GivNcbJCDM/edit?tab=t.0) to access your account
3. Follow step-by-step instructions available in [French](https://drive.google.com/file/d/11iFBV6PkA7phsXXgtIyHa79DlKwrY0Oh/view?usp=sharing) or [English](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1VzjaQYxnDrAQ8Ax5I6Z4y0XytxjPHNKi/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=115600862362829120699&rtpof=true&sd=true)
4. Designate and update beneficiaries as needed
